clinical_status: educational; supplied disease/symptom source has not been independently clinically validated
synthetic_generation: weighted symptom-profile sampling with limited nonspecific noise; balanced by condition
important_limit: The original rows are generated model-development examples, and imported profiles are dataset-derived; neither should be represented as patient outcomes or proof of clinical diagnostic accuracy.
merge_policy: normalize disease and symptom labels; merge duplicate disease labels into one class; merge duplicate symptom names into one feature; retain original rows and append one source profile per unique imported disease
